lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Can we talk about Saturday for a minute?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Sure. Is this about the sleepover?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Yes. I feel left out when a family plan is confirmed before we discuss it. I heard about this one after you had already told our daughter it was happening.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I checked the shared calendar and didn't see anything there, so I thought Saturday was free.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: What happened was that I hadn't added my morning training session yet. I know the calendar wasn't complete, but I still need us to check with each other before we confirm an overnight plan.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I understand. Are you asking me not to make plans with her friends?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: No. I'm not asking you to stop making plans. What would help is a quick message before either of us says yes.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: That sounds workable. I also need us to add work commitments as soon as we know about them.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Fair. I'll add the training tonight. Could we move the sleepover to Sunday?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Yes. I'll check with the other parent before I confirm it.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Thank you. So the change is: update the calendar, send a message, then confirm.
